( Case study 02 )Creator · Fitness & Finance

Fitfinfluencer

From zero to 63K+ followers across Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube — in six months.

Client
Fitfinfluencer
Sector
Creator · Fitness & Finance
Platforms
Instagram · Facebook · X · YouTube
Timeline
6 months
01~30KInstagram followers
0222KFacebook followers

( Overview )

Fitfinfluencer is a creator brand built where fitness meets finance — discipline in the gym and discipline with money. We launched it from scratch six months ago, with zero followers on any platform, and built its audience across four channels at once.

( 01 — The challenge )

Starting from nothing, in two of the most crowded niches online. No audience, no content library, no algorithmic history — and a position that had to be sharp enough to stand out from day one.

( 02 — Our approach )
  1. 01

    Own the intersection

    Instead of competing as one more fitness page or one more finance page, we positioned the brand where the two meet, with a clear point of view and a consistent voice.

  2. 02

    Instagram as the engine

    A high-frequency system of Reels and carousels: hook-first openings, recurring series and save-worthy formats designed to make following a habit.

  3. 03

    One idea, four platforms

    Every core idea was adapted natively for Facebook, X and YouTube — the right edit, caption and format for each platform, not copy-paste reposting.

  4. 04

    Weekly optimisation

    Reach, saves, shares and follower growth reviewed every week. The formats that won became series; the rest were dropped.

( 03 — What we made )
  • Reels
  • Carousels
  • YouTube videos & Shorts
  • X posts & threads
  • Facebook videos
  • Captions & copy
  • Content calendar
( 04 — The results )

In six months Fitfinfluencer went from zero to almost 30K followers on Instagram, 22K on Facebook, 6K on X and 5K subscribers on YouTube: more than 63,000 followers across four platforms, from a standing start.

( Key learnings )
“A new brand doesn’t need a head start. It needs a sharp position and a system that ships every day.”
